name: Parapet Thrasher
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to an opponent, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• Destroy target artifact that opponent controls.
• This creature deals 4 damage to each other opponent.
• Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to an opponent, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• Destroy target artifact that opponent controls.
• This creature deals 4 damage to each other opponent.

needs.what: a batched combat-damage trigger that fires once per damaged opponent ("one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to an opponent") and binds that single damaged player, so the effects can say "artifact that opponent controls" (a target selector with controller = the bound player) and "each other opponent" (opponents excluding the bound player)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: creatures_deal_combat_damage fires once per damaging player per step with every hit seat folded into one `damaged` list (combat._fire_damage_batch), and `damaged` is not in triggers.EVENT_BINDING_KEYS, so there is neither a per-opponent firing nor a single 'that opponent' binding; deals_combat_damage_to_player is per creature, so two Dragons hitting the same opponent would trigger twice instead of once
